pages.title: Under guard
pages.text: A great tree some fifty blocks tall, guarded by $(thing)three mavkas$() who attack every hostile creature.$(br2)It is more than a home to them: they are bound to it and will not let just anyone approach unpunished.

pages.title: Advice
pages.text: $(li)$(#7952A6)Size up the situation.$() Not every fight is worth the effort.$(li)$(#7952A6)A Chuhaister weakens$() near this tree, so the mavkas overcome it more easily.
